name: Auto Parts Connection
old_description: Whether you're coming in for a new motor, bumper, or new lights, we promise that you will be completely satisfied with your replacement parts. We provide warranties on most of our products to ensure your peace of mind.
about:
Auto Parts Connection operates a retail shop at 3853 E. Craig Road in North Las Vegas, Nevada. The business has been serving the Las Vegas area since at least 2021, as indicated by its website copyright. Ownership details and founding year are not publicly disclosed.

The shop specializes in replacement auto parts such as motors, bumpers, and lighting assemblies, and also offers instrument panel rebuilding services. All parts are sourced from established brands, and the company provides warranties on most items. A single location serves walk-in customers six days a week, with a staff that collectively holds over 20 years of automotive parts experience.

The customer base consists primarily of individual vehicle owners seeking repairs or maintenance. Reviews highlight transactions ranging from air-filter assemblies for passenger cars to hard-to-find components for pickup trucks, as well as same-day instrument cluster rebuilds. The business does not appear to target commercial fleets or wholesale buyers.

The company emphasizes a stress-free buying experience backed by knowledgeable personnel and a quality promise. Its stated differentiators include warranties on most products, a commitment to sourcing from reputable manufacturers, and a reported 24-hour turnaround for instrument panel work.
